text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... *wheeze*...

The final training push for the Mile CS.
Her breath grew thin. Yet even that shallow breathing—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahh!!

—Transforming into sharpness.
Honed to an ultimate, piercing edge.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah....
Trainer... Did we...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming so much unbelievable bad luck,
you've pushed forward. All the way to this point.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Up until a certain point, it felt almost comfortable
being led by destiny... by fate.
Yet, somewhere along the way...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That alone was no longer enough.
I began to want to transcend destiny itself.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing one's destiny, yet striving to overcome it.
People call that—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Possibility, is that what you call it?

Even higher than the world's highest peak.
In order to stand there and prove what's possible,
Seeking the Pearl...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
One more lap...! To achieve the possible
that's as close to impossible as it gets!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely beat Taiki in the mile too!
HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!"
And then—the day of the decisive battle arrived.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And once again, both Umamusume stand side by side!
Taiki Shuttle and Seeking the Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This time, nobody knows! Nobody can say for sure!
All we know is whoever wins here is this year's Sprint King!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. You're thinking it, aren't you, Taiki?
That you have a slight advantage this time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That if you just do your best, you're bound to win.
Are you?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Are we certain to win...?
The answer to that is...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —No♪ No, Pearl-san.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh... No?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The reason I lost the other day
wasn't because I was at a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because Pearl-san is ALWAYS strong!
No matter the distance, I can't let my guard DOWN.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That is why even today, I never assume victory is guaranteed. But!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely gonna win, y'all☆

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki, you...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufu! Magnificent. Very good.
You truly are a champion worthy
of respect.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're here with me. Because you're by my side,
I can challenge odds that are practically zero.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Taiki, let us begin.
The final match of this year!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than who conquered the world first,
let's compete to see who is the strongest right now♪"
